steps.message: Move the file sci_fi_book.mp3 from Notifications within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area to the Audiobooks within the same sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area in the Android filesystem.

Execute: adb shell "set -e; SRC=''; BASE=''; for b in /storage/emulated/0 /sdcard; do if [ -f \"$b/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3\" ]; then SRC=\"$b/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3\"; BASE=\"$b\"; break; fi; done; [ -n \"$SRC\" ]; DST=\"$BASE/Audiobooks\"; mkdir -p \"$DST\"; mv \"$SRC\" \"$DST/\"; ls -l \"$DST/sci_fi_book.mp3\"; [ ! -e \"$SRC\" ]"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "set -e; SRC=''; BASE=''; for b in /storage/emulated/0 /sdcard; do if [ -f \"$b/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3\" ]; then SRC=\"$b/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3\"; BASE=\"$b\"; break; fi; done; [ -n \"$SRC\" ]; DST=\"$BASE/Audiobooks\"; mkdir -p \"$DST\"; mv \"$SRC\" \"$DST/\"; ls -l \"$DST/sci_fi_book.mp3\"; [ ! -e \"$SRC\" ]""

extra.finish_description: Moved sci_fi_book.mp3 from Notifications to Audiobooks within the same sdk_gphone_x86_64 shared storage area.
